summary: Preserve bounded catalog and SEC workflows, source-filtered offline search, shared connection settings, and configurable SEC contact identity.
reason: The catalog APIs expose different metadata and pagination shapes; SEC requires a contact User-Agent, explicit filing bounds, and exact XBRL units and periods. Local snapshot analysis must not imply full-catalog completeness or deletions. Explicit profile logout must remain logged out without deleting shared global credentials; save reporting must use the actual selected credential route.
